name: Lovable Desktop
desc: Native macOS app that runs the Lovable editor outside the browser.
desc_zh: 在浏览器之外运行 Lovable 编辑器的 macOS 原生应用。
solves: Building in a tab means fighting the browser for focus and losing local tools; the desktop app keeps the project one keystroke away.
solves_zh: 在浏览器标签里做应用总要和浏览器抢焦点，还用不上本地工具；桌面版让项目一键可达。
best_for: You keep Lovable open all day next to your editor and want local MCP servers wired in.
best_for_zh: 你整天把 Lovable 和编辑器并排开着，还想接上本地 MCP 服务。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — docs.lovable.dev/changelog）。 Dated Apr 24, 2026, three days before the window opens; not in the ledger, so rule (b). Windows support arrived Jul 6, 2026 in the same changelog. The App Store listing for Lovable carries releaseDate 2026-04-27, consistent with a late-April launch. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：厂商没有公布中文名，name_zh 按 name。 首次公开日期来源：https://docs.lovable.dev/changelog
